questions.q: Wall type label matches the wall (fire/acoustic rating marked)?
questions.source: Errigal ITP – setting out & wall type

questions.q: Deflection head fitted with its movement gap kept clear (EPR: ±30 mm), boards not screwed to the head channel?
Track fixings at max 600 mm centres, first fixing within 50 mm of the end?

questions.q: Ask the fitter: What deflection gap is needed at the head, and should the studs be screwed to the head track? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Pattresses and noggins in for fixtures (WCs, basins, rails, TVs) before boarding?
Back boxes and hockey sticks at the coordinated positions; acoustic boxes in separating walls?
Head/base track fixings with at least 35 mm embedment?
questions.source: Errigal ITP checklist – head & base tracks

questions.q: Door frame-to-wall gaps over 10 mm sealed with intumescent acrylic?
Door stop fixings: steel screws into studs by at least 35 mm?

notOk.t: Studs screwed to the head track (kills the deflection)
Starter stud fixings missing or first fixing 300+ mm from the end
No stud at corners (board will flap)
Stud cut through for conduit / service holes damaged
GFS1 / pattress plate in the wrong position or on the stud face
Head track with a single fixing; conduit inside the deflection head
Wrong cloaking channel at shaftwall ends

ask.q: What stud and track fixing centres?
ask.a: Studs max 600 mm (400 mm where specified); track fixings max 600 mm, first within 50 mm of the end.

ask.q: What movement does the deflection head allow?
ask.a: ±30 mm (EPR 22) – boards not screwed into the head channel.
